hints.title: Transaction Product Name Resolution
hints.text: Retrieve product name, transaction year, and transaction price for each recorded sale by joining with the product catalog.

hints.title: Inner Equi-Join on Product Identifier
hints.text: Join Sales with Product on product_id and project product_name, year, and price.

hints.title: Sales Analysis Blueprint
hints.text: select p.product_name, s.year, s.price from Sales s join Product p on s.product_id = p.product_id.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT p.product_name, s.year, s.price
FROM Sales s
JOIN Product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id;
```

variables: S: number of records in Sales
P: number of records in Product
complexity.notes: Hash join on indexed product_id executes in linear scan time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Selecting product_name without joining the Product table is invalid schema syntax.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inner join projects matching names without allocating intermediate tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of clean INNER JOIN on product_id.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def sales_analysis(sales: pd.DataFrame, product: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = sales.merge(product, on='product_id')
    return merged[['product_name', 'year', 'price']]
